timeline_id.description: TimelineID is the ID of the annotation's timeline.

event_id.description: EventID is the event annotated; null for an annotation on the whole timeline.

kind.description: Kind is evidence or comment. Consumers must accept values they do not know.

author.description: Author is the person who added the annotation, not necessarily its source.

source.description: Source is the name of the source the annotation came from.

url.description: URL is a permalink to the thing itself, such as the log line or chat message.

created_at.description: CreatedAt is when the annotation was added to coroner.

updated_at.description: UpdatedAt is when the annotation was last changed in coroner.

Annotation.description: Annotation is evidence or commentary attached to an event, or to its whole timeline.

event_id.description: EventID is the event the file is kept with; null when an annotation keeps it.

annotation_id.description: AnnotationID is the annotation the file is kept with; null when an event keeps it.

filename.description: Filename is the attached file's name, as display text; never a path.

mime.description: MIME is the media type detected when the file was attached, possibly with parameters such as charset.

sha256.description: SHA256 is the SHA-256 of the file's content, as 64 lowercase hex digits.

size.description: Size is the size of the file's content, in bytes.

created_at.description: CreatedAt is when the file was attached in coroner.

Attachment.description: Attachment is a file kept with one event or annotation. An export carries its metadata and hash, never its bytes.

timeline_id.description: TimelineID is the ID of the event's timeline.

seq.description: Seq is the event's permanent per-timeline counter value; null only in a preview of an event not yet added.

occurred_at.description: OccurredAt is when the event happened, or its interval started: the start of its precision window.

occurred_offset.description: OccurredOffset is the input's offset from UTC in seconds, positive east; null when the input was Z or an epoch, which say nothing about a local offset.

precision.description: Precision is how exact occurred_at is, from day to nanosecond. Consumers must accept values they do not know.

approximate.description: Approximate marks occurred_at as a guess.

occurred_raw.description: OccurredRaw is the time exactly as it was given.

ended_at.description: EndedAt is when the interval ended; null for an event at a single moment.

source.description: Source is the name of the source the event came from.

tags.description: Tags are lowercase keywords, such as phase:detect.

url.description: URL is a permalink to the thing itself, such as the log line or chat message.

author.description: Author is the person who added the event, not necessarily its source.

created_at.description: CreatedAt is when the event was added to coroner.

updated_at.description: UpdatedAt is when the event was last changed in coroner.

Event.description: Event is something that happened at a moment, or over an interval, as a source reported it.

from_event_id.description: FromEventID is the event the link leaves.

to_event_id.description: ToEventID is the event the link reaches.

kind.description: Kind is led_to, same_as or copied_from. Consumers must accept values they do not know.

created_at.description: CreatedAt is when the link was added in coroner.

author.description: Author is the person who added the link.

Link.description: Link is a directed, typed link from one exported event to another, in the same timeline or another.

timelines.description: Timelines are the names of the timelines exported.

since.description: Since keeps events that occurred at or after it.

until.description: Until keeps events that occurred before it.

sources.description: Sources keeps events from any of these source names.

tags.description: Tags keeps events carrying all of these tags.

contains.description: Contains keeps events whose text contains it, ignoring ASCII case.

limit.description: Limit caps how many events were exported.

order.description: Order is which end Limit kept events from: asc the earliest, desc the latest. Exported events are listed in ascending order either way.

Query.description: Query is the selection an export was made with. Every field but Timelines and Order filters events, and null or an empty list means that filter was not applied.

name.description: Name is the source's name, such as slack or db-2/mongod.

created_at.description: CreatedAt is when the source was first recorded in coroner.

Source.description: Source is the system, service or person an event or annotation came from.

name.description: Name is the timeline's unique name, such as mongo-outage.

title.description: Title is a free-text heading; it may be empty.

refs.description: Refs are issue-tracker keys or URLs the timeline belongs to, kept as written.

created_at.description: CreatedAt is when the timeline was created in coroner.

Timeline.description: Timeline is the named chronology of one investigation.

format_version.description: FormatVersion is the MAJOR.MINOR version of the export format.

coroner_version.description: CoronerVersion is the version of coroner that wrote the export.

exported_at.description: ExportedAt is when the export was written.

query.description: Query is the selection the export was made with.

sources.description: Sources are the sources the exported events and annotations name.

events.description: Events are the exported events, from every exported timeline.

attachments.description: Attachments are the attachments of the exported events and annotations.

links.description: Links are the links between exported events.

description: Envelope is a whole export: what was exported, by which coroner, when and with which query, and the flat record lists.
